'''Horizon Media Group''' is the media arm of [[HN Group]], telling stories for the group and the businesses it works with.<ref>[https://hngroup.org.uk/companies Our companies], hngroup.org.uk.</ref>

== Activities ==
* '''Media and content''' — content and media for the group and the businesses it works with
* '''Press enquiries''' — media and press enquiries to the group are directed to Horizon Media Group through the HN Group contact form<ref>[https://hngroup.org.uk/contact?topic=media Contact], hngroup.org.uk.</ref>

== History ==
On 1 September 2026, Horizon Media Group merged with [[Horizon Network]] to form [[HN Group]], which became its owner. Horizon Media Group kept its name, brand and its subsidiary [[Horizon Advertising]], and its staff moved to HN Group.<ref>[https://news.hngroup.org.uk/#article-5e9bd91db3d9ece8a6b701a0 Horizon Network and Horizon Media Group merge to form HN Group], HN Group News.</ref>

== Structure ==
{{Company ownership|Horizon Media Group}}

Its staff use email addresses at '''media.hngroup.org.uk'''. [[Horizon Advertising]] is a subsidiary of Horizon Media Group, but is managed by [[Horizon Network]].

{{Company tree}}

== Brand ==
[[File:horizon-media-group-roundel.svg|thumb|The Horizon Media Group roundel]]
Horizon Media Group's logo is a thick indigo ring containing the initials '''HM''', alongside the company name. The roundel is also used on its own and as an app icon.
